subject: Initial request: Avalon Health procurement — IRP & SIG evidence
messages:
From: Nancy Ross <nancy.ross@avalonhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Avalon Health Procurement <procurement@avalonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IR plan + SIG/SOC2 evidence for procurement review

Hi Kimberly,

Following up on our vendor intake conversation — Avalon Health's procurement team is starting the security review for Redwood Inference. Our legal and security teams have a couple of discrete asks to move the contract forward:

1) A current Incident Response Plan (IRP) PDF we can include in our security binder.
2) A SIG questionnaire export or a quick mapping of SIG controls to your SOC 2 artifacts. If you have a CSV index or an evidence manifest, that would be ideal.
3) Any recent incident postmortems or an outline of your notification cadence (time-to-detect, time-to-notify customers) — high level is fine for now.

Target timeline: procurement would like these artifacts by EOD next Monday (2026-09-07) to hit our review window. If that's not possible, please let me know an ETA and any blockers.

Also, do you have a point of contact for follow-up questions from our security team? They prefer a single technical contact they can send clarifying questions to.

Thanks,
Nancy Ross
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Avalon Health
nancy.ross@avalonhealth.com
Attachment: procurement-questionnaire-avalon.xlsx (referenced)

Hi Nancy — thanks for the clear list and the timeline. We can meet your request. Quick summary and next steps: 

- I am the primary contact for technical / security follow-ups (kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com).
- Attached: RWI_IRP_v2.1.pdf (incident response plan, redacted for public distribution) and SOC2-SIG-evidence-index.csv (mapping of SIG controls to internal artifacts).
- We will also provide a short incident-notification summary (high-level metrics: typical detection windows, notification SLA) by EOD Monday.

Notes on attachments: the IRP is the operational plan — it references internal runbooks and on-call rotations. The evidence index lists artifacts we can share under NDA (e.g., runbook excerpts, audit logs snapshots, redacted Jira tickets). If Avalon needs specific raw artifacts (log exports, SIEM screenshots), please send the procurement form or a list of items and we will route through InfoSec for redaction.

If procurement prefers, we can set a 30-minute sync with your security reviewer to walk the mapping live next week.

Thanks — attaching the two files now.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
